svg.text: 保留产品页面外壳，中间题目内容区做成真题纸面风格

svg.text: 重点是先看材料 / 图片 / 图表，再看 Directions 和写作要求，阅读顺序尽量贴近真实考试。

text.font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 51. Directions:

text.font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing.

text.font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: In your essay, you should first describe the drawing, then interpret its

text.font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: meaning, and give your comment on it.

text.font-family: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Write no less than 160 words. (20 points)

text.font-family: Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 题目附件先于 Directions 展示，符合先看题面素材、再读写作任务的阅读顺序。
